_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: TWO lanes landed today. NEW — the CCR mountain has a plan: instead of you grinding 7,700 merge decisions, the merge rules are now WRITTEN DOWN (kb/merge_doctrine.md), Fable pre-decided 78 sample groups against them, and the Suggested-merges popup grew a 🧠 Mind-meld panel — it asks you the exact question each group raises and you answer BY VOICE (🎤 Dictate). Your spoken reasoning is what turns the draft rules into YOUR rules; once they match your judgment (target ≥90% agreement), Fable batch-decides the rest and the worklist drops to the few genuinely hard calls. ALSO (Session 97): Activities tab decluttered, one slim bar at the top, sidebar grouped into five sections, Custom Report absorbed the Master Report + Elevation slider + progress bar, MAP naming locked everywhere.

items.text: MIND MELD (the big one, ~45 min when you can): open ✨ Suggested merges and work a handful of groups with the new 🧠 Mind-meld panel — hit 🎤 Dictate and think aloud (why merge, why keep, where the ESL-style packaging line sits). Every note trains the doctrine. The KIN/Dance/Music 'one row per activity?' question (Q-TARGETCOUNT) is the single highest-leverage answer you can give — 9 of the 78 sample calls hinge on it.

REACT: kb/doctrine_out/2026-07-03/calibration_review.md holds Fable's 78 pre-decided merge/mint calls (stratified across every hard pattern) with the reasoning spelled out. Skim any section — agree/disagree out loud via the 🧠 panel or in the doc. Disagreements are the gold.

AFTER Sam's voice pass: distill merge_doctrine_notes → Doctrine v1, re-measure agreement on a fresh sample (gate ≥90%), then batch pass 2 (doctrine-v1@bot, all six lanes, dry-run→skim→apply) + the ESL packaging pilot. Full queue: docs/ccr_convergence_handoff.md.

NEW LOOK: open the Activities tab (sidebar now says just 'Activities', inside the Workplan group). The slim bar sits at the top; 📊 Custom Report now holds BOTH reports — pick ⚡ narrative or 📋 Master, set the audience and the new Elevation slider (sea level = full detail, 30,000 ft = board brief), and watch the progress bar instead of 'Generating…'. Tell Fable if any band's length/detail feels off.

SIDEBAR: the rail is grouped (Workplan / Funding / Strategy & Impact / Reference & Curation / Sierra & Team Tools / Share). Click a header to open or collapse; your layout is remembered per browser. If a grouping feels wrong, say which tab belongs where — it's a one-line change.

MERGE WHEN READY: a draft PR on cpl-knowledge-base fixes the wrong MAP expansion ('Map Academic Pathways') in the assistant instructions and adds the naming conventions (CPL Initiative / Mapping Articulated Pathways platform / old name history-only). Curation-gated — your review is the audit.

RATIFY: docs/team_phrase_expansion_plan.md answers your team-phrase question — widen most remaining magic-link gates in two phases; keep four reviewer-only (TMC CO-approval, phrase management, project hard-delete) and hold the public Fact Sheet. Say 'go Phase 1' and next session executes.

Sierra day-2 (carryover): the naming rule is now LIVE in the 🧭 guidance pane (deactivate, never delete). Add your own first rule; try the team-session tools; 👎 anything off.

HEADLINE NEXT BUILD (decided, carried over): native team-only attachments — private Supabase Storage bucket + project_attachments table + per-card ⬆ Attach; spec in session_97_handoff.md. SharePoint 📎 stays until it lands.
TOP DATA ASK (mid-July): fresh COCI course extract, ideally WITH contact-hours columns; and can the CO export the 200+ pending ADT submissions as a simple list (college, TMC, date)?
